integrity: Two independent exhaustive generators produce the same 2048 rotation classes. Two independent discrepancy calculations agree cycle by cycle, and the minimum-layer complement/reversal orbit decomposition is regenerated during replay.
scientific_limitations: The result is a complete finite census only at binary order five. It does not give a distribution formula or asymptotic density for larger orders, and unindexed earlier computations could contain the same small-order histogram.
title: Complete discrepancy census for binary order-five de Bruijn sequences
